Package be.imgn.json.bind

@NullMarked package be.imgn.json.bind
The annotations that bind records to JSON, through code that the annotation processor of be.imgn.json:json-processor generates: JsonRecord and the annotations that tune it.

  • Class
    Description
    JsonName
    Gives the name of a record component's member, the string of an enum constant, or the tag that names a record in a sealed interface, in place of its Java name.
    JsonRecord
    Marks a record, or a sealed interface of records, that documents bind to, with JsonParser#parseAs(Class, byte[]), and that JsonWriter#formatAs(Class, Object) writes.
    JsonTagMember
    Lays out a sealed interface as an object of its record whose tag member names the record, wherever it is among the members: {"type": "circle", "radius": 1}.
    JsonWrapper
    Lays out a sealed interface as an object with one member, named after the record, whose value is the record: {"circle": {"radius": 1}}.
    UnknownMembers
    What binding does with a member of an object that no component of the record takes.
